theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  have key : ∀ ⦃s₁ s₂ : Process Name Constant⦄, ChoiceBisim (defs := defs) s₁ s₂ →
      ∀ ⦃s₁' : Process Name Constant⦄ ⦃μ : Act Name⦄, Tr (defs := defs) s₁ μ s₁' →
        ∃ s₂', Tr (defs := defs) s₂ μ s₂' ∧ ChoiceBisim (defs := defs) s₁' s₂' := by
    intro s₁ s₂ hr s₁' μ htr
    cases hr with
    | choice hb =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL hp => exact (hb.follow_fst hp).imp fun _ x => ⟨Tr.choiceL x.1, .bisim x.2⟩
      | choiceR hp => exact ⟨s₁', Tr.choiceR hp, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl s₁')⟩
    | bisim hb => exact (hb.follow_fst htr).imp fun _ x => ⟨x.1, .bisim x.2⟩
  have sym : ∀ ⦃s₁ s₂ : Process Name Constant⦄,
      ChoiceBisim (defs := defs) s₁ s₂ → ChoiceBisim (defs := defs) s₂ s₁
    | _, _, .choice h => .choice h.symm
    | _, _, .bisim h => .bisim h.symm
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, fun s₁ s₂ hr μ => ⟨fun _ htr => key hr htr, fun _ htr => ?_⟩⟩
  exact (key (sym hr) htr).imp fun _ x => ⟨x.1, sym x.2⟩
